svg.text: A reviewable runtime architecture diagram: edge admission, ownership fencing, lane serialization, broker matching, DSQL persistence, scanners, and projection.

text.tspan: Solid arrows are synchronous request/data flow. Dashed arrows are control or async side paths.
Numbers are explained in the annotation panel, not squeezed onto the lines.
Map shard to lane: shard_id % lane_count.

svg.text: Per-run serialization by construction: same RunKey ⇒ same lane ⇒ sequential processing.

text.tspan: Timer scanner and WFT-timeout scanner submit lane commands; they never mutate run state directly.
Tier A: sync-match poller waiting → instant handoff.
Tier C: durable backlog via DSQL fallback.
Keyed by namespace / task queue / kind / deployment / sticky.
